content: Concrete example: AXCategoricalDataAxisDescriptor(title:, categoryOrder: [String]) for a String-keyed x-axis (matches WeekdayBarChart's weekday labels and AlcoholAreaChart's date-derived keys); AXNumericDataAxisDescriptor(title:, range: ClosedRange<Double>, gridlinePositions:, valueDescriptionProvider: (Double) -> String) for the y (grams) axis; AXDataSeriesDescriptor(name:, isContinuous: Bool, dataPoints: [AXDataPoint]) with .init(x:,y:) per point.
